name: design
title: Design & decide - research, options, decision record (no code)
titleAr: تخطيط وقرار — بحث ← بدائل ← قرار موثّق (من غير كود)
description: Planning-only pipeline. Nothing is implemented: you get a researched plan, an options comparison grounded in the real codebase, and a decision record you can hand to the task flow later.

stages.title: Ground the problem
stages.prompt:
Question: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT} (inventory in .workbench/artifacts/context.md). Establish the CURRENT reality relevant to this question: which modules own it today, how data flows, which constraints (build, deps, conventions, policies) any solution must respect. Cite file:line for every claim. Write analysis.md per your role contract.
done: analysis.md describes the current implementation with file:line citations
analysis.md lists the hard constraints a solution must satisfy

stages.title: Options & decision
stages.prompt:
Question: {TASK}

Grounding: .workbench/artifacts/analysis.md (project {PROJECT}). Produce a decision record in .workbench/artifacts/plan.md containing: Problem, Constraints, at least three candidate approaches each with cost/risk/effort and why it fits or not, the Recommended approach with justification, a step-by-step implementation plan for it, testable acceptance criteria, and what would make you change your mind. Do NOT write any product code.
stages.gateQuestion: Read the decision record in plan.md - approve this direction?
stages.gateQuestionAr: اقرا القرار في plan.md — توافق على الاتجاه ده؟
done: plan.md compares at least three approaches with cost/risk/effort
plan.md states one recommendation with explicit justification
plan.md ends with testable acceptance criteria and a step-by-step plan
No source file outside .workbench/ was modified

stages.title: Devil's advocate
stages.prompt: Review the decision record .workbench/artifacts/plan.md for the project at {PROJECT} as a hostile reviewer: attack every assumption, check each claim against the actual code, and hunt for a cheaper or simpler option the author missed. Write review.md with your findings and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS (the plan holds) or VERDICT: FAIL (it does not).
stages.gateQuestion: Review of the plan is ready - is the plan good to keep?
stages.gateQuestionAr: مراجعة الخطة جاهزة — الخطة تمام كده؟
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
Every challenged claim is checked against the code with a citation
